name: Aisai ~Tsuma to Oyaji Dake no Toki~
original_name: 哀妻 ～妻と親父だけの時間～
source: The protagonist, Tomokazu Mihara, lives with his beloved wife, Maho, and his father in their family home. They started living together about a year ago, after Tomokazu's mother suddenly passed away from an illness. His father initially lost the will to live and quit his job, but with Maho's support, he eventually recovered. However, as his energy returned, he began to develop inappropriate feelings towards his beautiful and young daughter-in-law. Unaware of his father's lust, Tomokazu and Maho start trying to conceive a child. They struggle to get pregnant, and Maho worries it's her fault. One day, after Tomokazu leaves for work, his father approaches Maho and offers to help with their fertility issues. He takes advantage of her vulnerability and forces himself on her. This continues, with the father-in-law pursuing Maho whenever he can, and Maho, fearing her husband will find out, being unable to resist. As time goes on, Maho becomes increasingly drawn to the intense and passionate encounters with her father-in-law.
translation: 主人公三原智和和他深爱的妻子真帆以及他的父亲住在他们的家中。大约一年前，智和的母亲突然因病去世后，他们开始同居。他的父亲最初失去了生存的意志并辞掉了工作，但在马霍的支持下，他最终康复了。然而，当他的能量恢复后，他开始对他美丽年轻的儿媳妇产生了不恰当的感情。智和和真帆没有意识到父亲的性欲，开始尝试怀孕。他们很难怀孕，玛霍担心这是她的错。有一天，智和去上班后，他的父亲找到真帆并提出帮助解决他们的生育问题。他利用她的脆弱，把自己强加在她身上。这样的情况继续下去，公公一有机会就追求马霍，而马霍担心她的丈夫会发现，无法反抗。随着时间的推移，玛霍越来越被与公公的激烈而热情的接触所吸引。
